card.name: Inside pexidartinib and GRAFAPEX names
card.fires_on: The piece 'ex' or 'X' inside certain drug names, mainly the 'ex' in pexidartinib (also pramipexole) and the final 'X' of GRAFAPEX. It marks a spot partway through a name.

modes.label: ex in pexidartinib
modes.description: The 'ex' piece after 'p' in pexidartinib, or in pramipexole.
modes.example: Oral administration of p<<ex>>idartinib to pregnant rats and rabbits

modes.label: X ending GRAFAPEX
modes.description: The last letter X of the brand name GRAFAPEX in label text.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of GRAFAPE<<X>> is 10 g/m 2

card.plain: It fires on the 'ex' or 'X' in pexidartinib and GRAFAPEX drug names.
